integrity: The proof is self-contained at the level of projective-plane incidence axioms and the standard magnitude-chain differential; computations are supplementary checks rather than evidence for the quantified theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only endpoint-localized bidegree \(3,4\) for distinct same-side endpoints in finite projective-plane incidence graphs. The replay checks prime-order Desarguesian examples \(q=2,3,5\); the general proof is axiomatic. No claim is made about all bidegrees or complete integral structure.
title: Endpoint-localized first off-diagonal magnitude homology of finite projective planes
